title: How to Set Up a TikTok Shop in 2026: Step-by-Step Guide for Sellers and Creators
summary: Learn how to set up a TikTok Shop step by step — Seller Center sign-up, verification, fees, and shipping — plus how to set up TikTok Shop as a creator and recruit affiliates.
body_markdown:
## Frequently Asked Questions


### Do you need 1,000 followers to open a TikTok Shop?


Sellers with an EIN can register through TikTok Shop Seller Center without any follower count. If you want to promote other shops' products as a creator for commission, you must be at least 18 and have 1,000 or more followers.


### How much does it cost to set up a TikTok Shop?


Setting up a TikTok Shop is free, but TikTok charges commission on sales. Review the fees shown for your specific products before setting prices.


### How do I activate my TikTok Shop?


To activate a TikTok Shop, register through Seller Center, select your country and business type, submit verification documents like an EIN or SSN, then configure shipping and payout details. Once verification clears and product listings are published, your shop goes live. Setup typically takes one to three days.


### Do you need an LLC to start a TikTok Shop?


No, an LLC is not required to start a TikTok Shop. TikTok lets individuals and sole proprietors register alongside corporations and organizations. Your business type choice determines which identity documents TikTok requests, so pick the category that matches your actual legal structure.


### Can I sell on TikTok Shop without a business?


Yes, you can sell on TikTok Shop without a registered business by registering as an individual or sole proprietor in Seller Center. You will still need to provide taxpayer details and a government ID for verification. Sellers with an EIN can register without meeting follower requirements.


### What is the difference between a seller account and a creator account on TikTok Shop?


A seller account is the merchant identity managed through Seller Center, where you control inventory, pricing, fulfillment, and payouts. A creator account is a TikTok profile used to publish shoppable content and earn commission promoting other shops' products. If you plan to do both, complete each registration path separately.


### What do I need to prepare before setting up a TikTok Shop?


Before applying, prepare your legal details, verification documents like an EIN or business license, a shipping and fulfillment plan, product information, and a verified payout account. Ensure names and addresses match across your application and documents. Missing or mismatched information is the most common cause of setup delays.
